requirements.requirement: The system must include a prescription_behavior field in the provider evaluation API response payload when RX data is available.
The system must structure the prescription_behavior payload to conform exactly to the schema defined in EVAL-P-RX-UX-S1.
The system must integrate prescription_behavior data within evaluate_care_facade.py without breaking existing response fields.
The system must ensure that provider evaluation responses without RX data omit the prescription_behavior field or set it to null.
The system must allow the frontend to detect the presence of prescription_behavior data via a deterministic key check.
The system must ensure that the frontend renders the prescription behavior module only when prescription_behavior data is present and valid.
The system must pass top_drugs, relevance_indicator, integrity_flag, and score_contribution fields through the API unchanged from backend computation.
The system must preserve ordering of top_drugs as provided by the backend in the API response.
The system must handle malformed prescription_behavior payloads by excluding the module from the response rather than causing a full response failure.
The system must log an error when prescription_behavior data fails schema validation during integration.
The system must ensure that chat response generation includes prescription behavior content when present in the payload.
The system must ensure the LLM references prescription behavior insights in the generated chat text when prescription_behavior data is present.
The system must ensure the LLM does not hallucinate prescription behavior details when prescription_behavior data is absent.
The system must ensure the LLM uses only fields provided in prescription_behavior payload when generating explanations.
The system must ensure the LLM correctly interprets integrity_flag values (clean or flagged) and reflects them accurately in the chat response.
The system must ensure the LLM summarizes top_drugs without altering their relative importance or introducing new drugs.
The system must ensure the LLM includes a relevance explanation when relevance_indicator is present.
The system must ensure the LLM avoids overemphasizing prescription behavior when score_contribution is low.
The system must return a valid provider evaluation response within existing latency thresholds after adding prescription_behavior integration.
The system must ensure backward compatibility such that clients not expecting prescription_behavior do not fail when receiving the field.
